title: Bug: time picker error
symptom: When entering a time for carbs, the displayed time can be off by one minute (e.g., entering 30 shows 31, entering 00 shows 01). The error depends on the actual time in seconds.
cause: The time offset is the primary source, and during conversion between offset and time, rounding occurs, causing a possible 1-minute difference.
fix: No fix provided; maintainer states it's not a bug but a rounding issue during conversion.
evidence_quote: I analyzed it and it can be 1 min different because of rounding during recalculation time offset.
